programmes: Aro Valley Community Centre — open access space, classes, and events
Neighbourhood composting and community garden network (12 sites)
Monthly community kai — free shared meals, open to all

community_development_and_engagement.evidence: 15 years operating Aro Valley Community Centre; 1,200+ residents engaged annually; 35 active volunteers

arts_culture_and_creative_programming.evidence: Annual arts residency programme; youth arts (weekly); community gallery space; partnered with Toi Whakaari and BATS Theatre

youth_programmes_and_rangatahi.evidence: Weekly youth arts programme (ages 10-18); school holiday programmes; youth-led community projects

environment_and_sustainability.evidence: 12-site composting and community garden network; zero-waste events; native planting days

kaupapa_maori_and_pacific_responsiveness.evidence: Tikanga Māori embedded in governance; partnership with Te Ātiawa ki Whakarongotai; bilingual signage and programming
